author: KamalaHarris
text:
Maternal health is about making sure every mother and baby has the care, support, and resources they need to thrive.

When it comes to resources, Medicaid is the largest funder for maternity care in America. Donald Trump — supported by Mike Rogers — cut Medicaid funding by $1 trillion dollars.

I am proud to be back in the great state of Michigan with @AbdulElSayed to discuss what is at stake on this critical issue in the midterm election. Michigan, Election Day is 42 days away. Make sure you are ready to vote for Abdul and help flip the Senate.
